# Time-Scoped Relation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TimeScopedRelation>
- **Category:** class
